'''December 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Face the Music, Rochester on 1 December 2001. [[Garrett Larson]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3135">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-rochester-deadbody-style-12-01-01d3135/ rochester-deadbody-style-12-01-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 2 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-rochester-deadbody-style-12-01-01d3135/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Face the Music, Rochester
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
